description: For an infinite regular cardinal k, the range and union of every family of members of H_k indexed by fewer than k indices belong to H_k.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.hereditaryLevel_small_family.{u} (κ : Cardinal.{u}) (hκ : κ.IsRegular)
  {ι : Type u} (x : ι → ZFSet.{u}) (hsize : Cardinal.mk ι < κ)
  (hx : ∀ (i : ι), x i ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.hereditaryLevel κ) :
  ZFSet.range x ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.hereditaryLevel κ ∧
    ZFSet.iUnion x ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.hereditaryLevel κ
